about.headline: Beauty, Backed by Science
about.storyOne: Dr. Karam AbdelRazek was founded on a simple belief: luxury skincare should be as effective as it is indulgent. What began as a dermatologist's personal formulations has grown into a full collection of skincare, makeup and fragrance — each product crafted with the same precision and care as the very first.
about.storyTwo: Today, we serve thousands of clients who trust us for formulas that deliver visible results, wrapped in an experience that feels as premium as the ingredients inside.
about.qualityDescription: Every formula is developed with dermatologists and tested rigorously before it reaches you.
about.ingredientsDescription: We source rare, effective actives — never filler, always intentional.
about.careDescription: From packaging to support, every touchpoint is designed around you.

basics.templatesDescription: Pick the kind of offer you have in mind. It only pre-fills the next steps: you can change everything afterwards.
basics.nameDescription: For your team only. Customers see the title below, or one written for them automatically.
basics.internalNotesPlaceholder: Why this campaign exists, who asked for it, anything worth remembering.
basics.scheduleDescription: A promotion only applies while it is active and inside these dates. Leave the start empty to begin as soon as it is activated, and the end empty to run until you stop it.
basics.timezoneNote: Times use this device’s time zone ({{zone}}) and are stored in UTC, so the promotion starts and ends at the same moment for every customer.
basics.cairoTimezoneNote: The shop runs on Cairo time, shown under each field.
basics.couponDescription: Without a code the promotion applies automatically to every cart that qualifies. With a code, only customers who enter it get it.
basics.codeHint: Entered in the cart’s coupon field. It cannot be the same as an existing coupon.
basics.showCode: Show the code on the storefront
basics.showCodeHelp: On: product pages show “Use code GLOW20”. Off: the offer is advertised as needing a code, without revealing it.
basics.showPromotion: Show this promotion on the storefront
basics.showPromotionHelp: Badges on product cards, details on product pages and “almost there” hints in the cart. Turn off for private codes: the promotion still applies, it is just not advertised.
basics.bannerDescription: Shown on the storefront’s Offers page and at the top of this promotion’s own page. A promo banner on the home page can link to that page.
basics.customerTextDescription: Leave these empty and the badge, summary and rules are written for you, in English and Arabic, from the promotion’s settings. Fill them in to use your own words.
basics.badgeHint: The short label over product images. Keep it under 20 characters.

products.groupUnused: Not used yet: the next steps let you pick it for the buy quantity, a condition or a reward.
products.groupStillUsed: Still used by {{uses}}: change that first.
products.groupNameHint: For your team. It appears in this builder and in the simulator.
products.scopeLegend: Which products are in this group?
products.allProductsHelp: Every product in the store, except any you exclude below.
products.selectedProductsHelp: Only the categories, brands and products you choose.
products.emptyGroup: This group is empty. Choose at least one category, brand or product, or switch to all products.
products.categoriesHint: Every product in a chosen category belongs to the group.
products.categoryIncluded: the whole category is already included
products.excludedProductsHint: Left out of the group even when a category or brand above includes them.
products.groupsIntro: A product group is a set of products the promotion refers to. One group is enough for a simple product discount. Use two when the products a customer buys and the products receiving the reward are different. Cart-wide discounts and gifts based on a cart total do not need a group.
products.noGroupsDescription: This promotion works on the whole cart. Add a group if it should depend on, or discount, particular products.

productPicker.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, brand or SKU…

aggregate.label: Across the group
aggregate.help: Any mix of products from the group counts: 1 serum + 1 toner = 2.

per_product.label: Per product
per_product.help: The quantity must be reached with one product: 2 of the same serum.

conditions.atMostHint: Above this the promotion no longer applies.
conditions.buyQuantityDescription: The “buy X” part of an offer. Each time the customer has this many units, the reward is given once, and those units are used up. Leave it off for a plain discount.
conditions.requireBuyQuantity: The customer must buy a quantity to earn the reward
conditions.qualifyingProductsHint: The qualifying products. Rewarded products are chosen in the next step and can be a different group.
conditions.extraConditionsDescription: Checks on the cart that must pass before the promotion applies, such as a minimum cart total. They are measured before discounts and never use units up.
conditions.noConditions: No extra conditions: the promotion applies to every cart with eligible products.
conditions.noConditionsWithTrigger: No extra conditions: the promotion applies to every cart that reaches the buy quantity.
conditions.combineConditions: How the conditions in this set combine
conditions.addConditionToSet: Add a condition to this set

cart_subtotal.label: Cart subtotal
cart_subtotal.help: The whole cart must be worth at least this much, before promotions.

group_subtotal.label: Spend on a product group
group_subtotal.help: The products of one group in the cart must be worth at least this much.

group_quantity.label: Quantity from a product group
group_quantity.help: The cart must hold this many units of a group. This only checks the quantity; it does not use the units up.

cart_quantity.label: Items in the cart
cart_quantity.help: The cart must hold this many units in total.

percent_off.label: Percentage off
percent_off.help: Takes a percentage off eligible products. With a buy quantity, it becomes a buy X get Y offer (100% = free).

fixed_off.label: Amount off
fixed_off.help: Takes a fixed amount off each eligible unit, or one amount spread over eligible items.
fixed_off.example: 50 EGP off each · Buy 2, save 100 EGP

fixed_price.label: Special price
fixed_price.help: Sells eligible units at a set price, whatever their normal price.

tiered_percent.label: Discount by unit position
tiered_percent.help: Each further unit gets its own discount: the first at full price, the second cheaper, the third cheaper still.

gift.label: Free gift
gift.help: Adds one or more specific products to the cart for free.
gift.example: Free mini cleanser with any serum

gift_choice.label: Gift of the customer’s choice
gift_choice.help: The customer picks from a list of gifts in their cart.

order_percent_off.label: Percentage off the cart
order_percent_off.help: Takes a percentage off the whole cart, after product offers.

order_fixed_off.label: Amount off the cart
order_fixed_off.help: Takes a fixed amount off the whole cart, after product offers.

free_shipping.label: Free delivery
free_shipping.help: The order is delivered for free, whatever the governorate.
free_shipping.example: Free delivery on orders over 1,500 EGP

rewards.everyOtherUnitHelp: Off: a set number of units is rewarded each time the buy quantity is met (the “get Y”).
rewards.restrictUnitsHelp: Off: only a set number of units is discounted.
rewards.rewardGroupHint: Can be the same group the customer buys from, or a different one.
rewards.amountSharedHelp: One amount in total, spread over rewarded units by price.
rewards.amountCannotExceedPrice: A unit is never discounted below zero: an amount larger than its price simply makes it free.
rewards.cheaperUnitsHint: Units already cheaper than this keep their own price.
rewards.zeroPercentHint: 0% means that unit is paid in full.
rewards.expensiveFirst: The most expensive (cheaper units get the discounts)
rewards.cheapestFirst: The cheapest (pricier units get the discounts)
rewards.unitsAcrossGroupHelp: A serum and a toner are the 1st and 2nd unit.
rewards.unitsPerProductHelp: Each product has its own 1st, 2nd, 3rd unit.
rewards.giftProductsHint: Each one is added to the cart for free. Hidden products can be gifts too.
rewards.requireGiftStock: Only while the gift is in stock
rewards.requireGiftStockHelp: When the gift runs out, customers are told it is unavailable. Turn this off to always add the gift, even at zero stock.
rewards.pickedProductsHelp: A fixed list of up to {{limit}} products.
rewards.groupOfProductsHelp: Every product in a product group. New products in it become gifts automatically.
rewards.customerChoosesGiftHint: The customer picks in the cart or at checkout. Nothing is added until they choose.
rewards.chooseGiftGroupHint: Choose its categories, subcategories or brands in step 2 (Products).
rewards.giftMaxValueHint: Keeps expensive products in the group from being given away.
rewards.giftGroupEmpty: “{{name}}” is still empty. Go to step 2 (Products) and choose which products can be gifts.
rewards.giftGroupAll: “{{name}}” includes every product in the store. Set a maximum value, or narrow the group in step 2.
rewards.giftGroupSelected: Customers can choose from the visible products in this group. Nothing is added until they choose.
rewards.giftGroupLimit: Up to {{limit}} gifts are offered at a time: in-stock items first, then the cheapest. Narrow large categories with a subcategory or maximum value.
rewards.giftChooseCount: How many gifts may the customer pick?
rewards.onlyInStockGifts: Only offer gifts that are in stock
rewards.onlyInStockGiftsHelp: Out-of-stock gifts are shown as unavailable and cannot be picked.
rewards.cartDiscountHint: Taken off after product offers, then spread over the items.
rewards.cartAmountHint: Cannot exceed the cart total. Delivery is not discounted.
rewards.freeShippingNote: Delivery costs 0 EGP on every order this promotion applies to. Set the minimum order value in Conditions (Cart subtotal, measured before discounts).
rewards.chooseRewardedProducts: Choose rewarded products below for each reward; they can be in the same group or a different one.
rewards.noBuyQuantity: There is no buy quantity, so each reward applies once to eligible products in the cart. For a buy X get Y offer, turn on buy quantity in the previous step.
rewards.allRewardsTogether: The customer receives all these rewards together, for example a discount and a gift.

rules.repeatingDescription: What happens when a customer qualifies more than once in the same order.
rules.repeatApplication: Apply again each time the buy quantity is reached
rules.repeatApplicationHelp: On: a cart that qualifies multiple times receives the reward each time. Off: once per order.
rules.qualifierCanBeReward: A unit that counts as “bought” may also receive the reward
rules.qualifierCanBeRewardHelp: Off (usual): buy 2 get 1 free needs 3 units. On: for offers like buy 3, get 10% off all 3.
rules.oncePerOrder: This promotion has no buy quantity, so it applies once per order.
rules.noLimitHint: Leave a field empty for no limit.
rules.limitsExplanation: Customers check out as guests, so a customer is identified by phone number. Cancelled orders return their use. Limits are enforced when the order is placed, even if many customers order at once.
rules.combiningDescription: Promotions run in a fixed order: product offers first, cart discounts after; within each, highest priority first, then oldest.
rules.priorityHint: Higher runs first. 0 is the default.
rules.canCombinePromotions: Can be combined with other promotions
rules.canCombinePromotionsHelp: Off: this promotion excludes its items from other offers and cannot use items already used by another offer.
rules.canCombineCoupons: Can be combined with coupon codes
rules.canCombineCouponsHelp: Off: when a customer enters a coupon, they get whichever saves more, this promotion or the coupon, never both.
rules.applyToDiscounted: Applies to items that are already discounted
rules.applyToDiscountedHelp: Off: items discounted by an earlier promotion are excluded from this one.
rules.exclusiveGroupDescription: Put competing promotions in the same group so only one applies to an order.
rules.belongsToExclusiveGroup: This promotion belongs to an exclusive group
rules.groupNameHint: Type a new name, or choose an existing group.
rules.winningPromotion: Which promotion in the group wins?
rules.priorityWinsHelp: By priority, then age. The savings are not compared.
rules.bestDiscountWins: The one that saves the customer most
rules.bestDiscountWinsHelp: Try every member; the largest saving wins. Ties go to the higher priority.
rules.groupMembersNotice: “{{name}}” already has {{count}} promotions. This rule belongs to the group, so saving changes it for all of them.

simulator.promotionDoesNotApply: This promotion does not apply to the sample cart:

simulator.description: Build a cart and see exactly what the customer would pay. It uses the same server pricing as the real cart and checkout, and changes nothing: no stock, orders or usage.
simulator.draftCouponHint: This promotion’s code ({{code}}) is used when empty.
simulator.testAlone: Test this promotion on its own
simulator.testAloneHelp: Off: test it with currently live promotions to see how they stack or conflict.
simulator.addProduct: Add at least one product to the sample cart.
simulator.cannotRun: This promotion cannot be simulated yet:

validation.endDateOrder: The end date must be after the start date.
validation.conditionMinimumRequired: A condition is missing its minimum.
validation.giftChoicesRequired: Reward {{count}}: offer at least 2 gifts to choose from, or use a product group.

validation.invalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address.
